description: This file contains a benchmark class for testing various data structures and algorithms related to top-k frequency estimation, including space-saving algorithms, sampling, and custom heap implementations, within the Orleans framework.

classes.name: EdgeClass
classes.description: A record class encapsulating an Edge object, used for frequency counting.

classes.name: EdgeFrequentItemCollection
classes.description: A specialized collection for managing frequent Edge items with a fixed capacity.

classes.name: EdgeClassFrequentItemCollection
classes.description: A specialized collection for managing frequent EdgeClass items with a fixed capacity.

classes.name: UlongFrequentItemCollection
classes.description: A collection for managing frequent ulong items with a fixed capacity.

classes.name: EdgeCounter
classes.description: A class representing a counter for an Edge, used in frequency estimation.

classes.name: FrequencySink
classes.description: Implements the space-saving algorithm for top-k frequency estimation, including an internal min-heap.

classes.name: ZipfRejectionSampler
classes.description: A class implementing rejection sampling for the Zipf distribution.

methods.name: GlobalSetup
methods.description: Initializes the sampling data, creates network topology, and prepares data structures for benchmarking.

methods.name: IterationSetup
methods.description: Prepares the state before each benchmark iteration (currently commented out).

methods.name: FssAdd
methods.description: Adds Edge samples to the EdgeFrequentItemCollection.

methods.name: SinkAdd
methods.description: Adds Edge samples to the FrequencySink for top-k frequency estimation.
